_source: Built from https://docs.bachs.io/api-reference/accounts/create-an-account.md (OrganizationResponse example) and https://docs.bachs.io/connect/requirements.md ('A person ... payouts, transfers: their name, and for payouts a payout account in their own name'), with the receive-only shape of the recorded S1 company account in packages/payments/test/bachs-business-shares.test.mjs (sandbox 11 Nov 2026: payouts, transfers and conversions active at once, requirements persons.name and payout_destination). entity_type individual. balance_currencies is USD only: a new account holds only USD until holdLocalCurrency adds NGN (/connect/accounts 'Currencies the account holds'; P12).
